executive_summary.headline: Three user-supplied Amazon links resolve to three verified air-fryer product pages. Prices, ratings, commission rates and trend data are not published, because they could not be verified or the Associates policy does not allow them on this site.
bullets: Re-verification (2026-11-14): each short link was resolved again; titles, breadcrumbs and also-viewed ASINs match the records. The Agreement's disclosure wording, the Participation Requirements text, the Conditions of Use licence and the FTC and Associates guidance were re-read. Corrections: policy section numbers (F-17), the 'Sponsored' label observations (F-10), and competitor labels marked as paraphrased (F-20). Brand bylines and specification tables were not re-read (F-18). The automation conflict with Program Policies is flagged (F-19).

Identity verified: each link resolves to an Amazon product page (ASINs B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH). All three sit under the same Amazon category path (Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers). Flag F-04 covers the short-link codes.

Pricing and ratings withheld: the Associates Participation Requirements (Section 2(b) and Section 6(t)) allow prices and star ratings on a site only through Amazon-served links or Creators API / PA API. The pages were read, but no price, rating or review count is published (F-02).
Commission potential not calculable: the category commission schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in, so no rate is entered (F-01). Third-party sources conflict on the Kitchen rate.
Attribution unverified: the resolved links contain no Associates tag parameter (F-03). Confirm the links are generated under your Associates ID before relying on any earnings.

Compliance: the required disclosure sentence appears on every page (R-01). Open legal items: the Conditions of Use limit collecting listing content, data mining and using Amazon content for AI models (F-11, F-12). The AI content automation is therefore NOT built.

Not built: automated product research, PA-API integration, click and conversion tracking, AI article generation and campaign optimisation. Each needs PA-API or Associates reporting access, a rate source, or a compliance decision first.
Site: static GitHub Pages site (source: main, path /; the root index.html redirects to docs/). Every table row links to an official source, and unverified values are blank and flagged.
decisions_needed: Confirm whether the links were generated under your Associates ID (F-03), and which Amazon marketplace they should target (F-09).
Read the category commission rate from Associates Central and send it for entry (F-01).
Choose whether to apply for PA-API / Creators API access so prices and ratings can be shown (F-02, F-16).
Decide whether automated research and AI article generation may use Amazon-derived data, after review (F-11, F-12).

analysis.finding: All three products are in one niche: countertop air fryers and air-fry toaster ovens.
analysis.basis: Breadcrumb on all three product pages: Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers.

analysis.finding: Two of the three products share a brand (Chefman). The third is Emeril (Item details table; byline to confirm, F-05).
analysis.basis: Brand byline on P1 and P3 reads Chefman. P2 shows store 'Emeril Store' and byline 'Innovation IQ' (F-05).
analysis.confidence: P2 brand from the Item details table, re-read 2026-11-14 (byline to confirm, F-05); P1 and P3 from the earlier session (byline not re-read, F-18)

analysis.finding: The set spans three formats: a 6-litre dual-basket oven (P1), an 8-quart single-basket air fryer (P3) and a 24.6-litre French-door toaster oven (P2).
analysis.basis: Capacity fields as listed. The units differ across title and specification (F-06), so values are shown as listed, not compared numerically.

analysis.finding: Amazon's own 'also viewed' lists show competing air fryers from at least six other brands. P1 and P3 each list another Chefman model.
analysis.basis: Also-viewed carousel (stored ASIN lists, first three items per product). On the 2026-11-14 read the P3 carousel is labelled 'Sponsored'; the P1 label was not seen on that read; P2 is not labelled (F-10). Carousel membership changes between page loads, so the lists are snapshots (F-23).
analysis.confidence: Verified as shown (re-read 2026-11-14); sponsored labels vary (F-10)

analysis.finding: Commission potential cannot be estimated on this site.
analysis.basis: Commission is a percentage of Qualifying Revenue (price less shipping, tax and similar items; Commission Income Statement, Section 1). The category rate is unverified (F-01), and prices may not be published (F-02). No earnings figure is given.

analysis.finding: Trend and conversion performance cannot be measured from verified sources.
analysis.basis: No official trend or conversion data was available. Amazon's on-page popularity badges are not reproduced (F-15).

analysis.finding: Attribution to the user's Associates account is not confirmed.
analysis.basis: The resolved product URLs carry no 'tag=' parameter (F-03).
